AMD Navi 24

Navi 24
Navi 24 XL
Navi 24 XT
AMD's Navi 24 GPU uses the RDNA 2 architecture and is made using a 6 nm production process at TSMC. With a die size of 107 mm² and a transistor count of 5.40 billion it is an average sized chip. Navi 24 supports DirectX 12 Ultimate (Feature Level 12_2). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.4. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 2.0 can be used. Additionally, the DirectX 12 Ultimate capability guarantees support for hardware-raytracing, variable-rate shading and more, in upcoming video games. It features 1024 shading units, 64 texture mapping units and 32 ROPs. The GPU also contains 16 raytracing acceleration cores.
Further reading: RDNA Whitepaper , RDNA2 ISA
